pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; standing tall on long hind legs, head held high and forward.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. Symmetrical and centered.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking slightly up to emphasize its elegant height and neck length.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The slender torso and long tail are completely occluded by the chest and upright neck. Silhouette width max 220px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The long, slender neck and small, bird-like head must be perfectly centered and extend vertically, with the beak clearly visible.

character_details.expression: Alert, curious, and gentle gaze; large, round, bird-like eyes.
character_details.texture: Smooth, downy feathers covering most of the body, with sleek, tighter feathers on the neck and head. Color: Soft tawny brown with cream underparts.
features: Long, powerful hind legs with small, delicate forelimbs tucked against the chest.

environmental_details.ground: Damp, dark soil mixed with rich leaf litter and fern fronds, characteristic of the Dinosaur Park Formation.
flora: Tall, lush horsetails and broad-leaved flowering plants (magnolias) in the soft-focus background, suggesting dense vegetation.
environmental_details.sky: Bright, humid Late Cretaceous sky with a soft, diffused glow that highlights the texture of the feathers.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed Cinematic' lighting, ensuring bright, clean surfaces with soft, inviting shadows.
